review_fix.blocking: Clean-control false-critical margin counted an invalid challenger reply as a clean pass. Fixed: a clean control not validly answered in both orders counts against the 0.05 ceiling and stays in the denominator; margins.cleanControl reports cases, critical and notValidlyAnswered. Plan text and hash unchanged (its success counting already required this).
review_fix.reproduced_scenario: Paid-shaped record, 20 seeded lineages detected by the challenger, 10 clean controls: with critical findings CHALLENGER_REGRESSES (rate 1); with invalid replies now rate 1, margin false, CHALLENGER_REGRESSES (was rate 0, margin true, PENDING_HUMAN_LABELS)

minor_findings.incumbent_flip_as_tie: fixed: a flip is its own outcome and never agrees with a human tie consensus
minor_findings.reimplemented_analysis: fixed: R06 assertHumanVotes, assertHumanDimensionVotes and humanConsensus exported and used; lineage bootstrap extracted as bootstrapLineageMeans and used by the R-study analysis and the experiment (bit-identical to the old R-study code on 200 generated cases); run records bind both image hashes and the challenger cases go through analyzeBlindJudgeCalibration, per dimension. Dimension results are reported as exploratory and do not enter the frozen decision rule: the incumbent has no matching dimensions, so no paired margin exists.
minor_findings.instruction_bounds: fixed in part: instructions up to 24,000 characters and must/mustNot items up to 1,000 inside the unchanged 30,000-character packet; a request that still cannot fit is refused, never truncated, and Core records errorCode with the unavailable judge so the class can be counted
minor_findings.identical_canary: fixed: no canary call is made; the pick is untested and not trusted; composite_judge_uncertain, judgeReliable null, humanChoiceRecommended true; Core records a canary row with passed null and the reason
minor_findings.human_choice_unread: fixed: the Desk Studio panel shows a request to choose when stages.tournament.humanChoiceRecommended is true; an unavailable judge now records it as true. Incumbent tie and canary-failure outcomes are unchanged and record false.
minor_findings.studio_ledger_failures: confirmed pre-existing: with apps/core/src restored to 7b8de71e the same 2 tests fail with db.transaction is not a function (ledger-base-source.log)
